IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives Alexander, Conway, Crouse, Simpson, Upthegrove and Chase; by request of Select Committee on Pension Policy)

Bill.BriefDescription: Changing the terms for vesting after five years of service in the defined benefit portion of the public employees' retirement system, the school employees' retirement system, and the teachers' retirement system plan 3.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vesting after five years of service in thedefined benefit portion of the public employees' retirement system, theschool employees' retirement system, and the teachers' retirementsystem plan 3; amending RCW 41.32.875, 41.35.680, and 41.40.820; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 41.32.875 and 2000 c 247 s 903 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) NORMAL RETIREMENT. Any member who is at least age sixtyfiveand who has: (a) Completed ten service credit years; or (b) Completed five service credit years, including twelve servicecredit months after attaining age ((fiftyfour)) fortyfour; or (c) Completed five service credit years by July 1, 1996, under plan2 and who transferred to plan 3 under RCW 41.32.817;shall be eligible to retire and to receive a retirement allowancecomputed according to the provisions of RCW 41.32.840. (2) EARLY RETIREMENT. Any member who has attained at least agefiftyfive and has completed at least ten years of service shall be p. 1 SHB 1320eligible to retire and to receive a retirement allowance computedaccording to the provisions of RCW 41.32.840, except that a memberretiring pursuant to this subsection shall have the retirementallowance actuarially reduced to reflect the difference in the numberof years between age at retirement and the attainment of age sixtyfive. (3) ALTERNATE EARLY RETIREMENT. Any member who has completed atleast thirty service credit years and has attained age fiftyfive shallbe eligible to retire and to receive a retirement allowance computedaccording to the provisions of RCW 41.32.840, except that a memberretiring pursuant to this subsection shall have the retirementallowance reduced by three percent per year to reflect the differencein the number of years between age at retirement and the attainment ofage sixtyfive.

If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided by p. 3 SHB 1320June 30, 2005, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
